name: Unforgiven Clean

band.style_feel: slow half-time ballad, heavy snare backbeat on 3, sparse intro drums
parts: Part A: intro/verse - clean arpeggio, sparse drums
Part B: heavy riff/chorus - full band
Part C: bridge/solo - full band, slower build
band.tips: Analyzers read 139-140 BPM, which is double time; set the Trio+ to about 70 BPM half-time. Play the intro arpeggio cleanly for 2 bars before it starts learning.

whammy.tuning: E standard (E A D G B E)
how: Tune your guitar to standard (E A D G B E).
Leave the Whammy DT off (bypassed); no pitch effect is needed.
whammy.tips: Tabs list standard tuning; no whammy or octave effect found for this song (the harmonies are a second guitar), so none is needed.

memo: Metallica - The Unforgiven: clean chorused arpeggio intro/verse, JC-style clean with chorus and a touch of delay.

name: Unforgiven Crunch
memo: Metallica - The Unforgiven: heavy chorus rhythm, tight Mesa-style crunch, mids slightly scooped.

name: Unforgiven Lead
memo: Metallica - The Unforgiven: Hammett-style lead solo, boosted lead channel with delay.
